author: petr1petr
body:
at T9, you should go with ward

ring of day/ night --> there is gizmo and gadget, if you dont have these, there is panacea (potion)

I would switch weapon element to water (for freeze status)

sorrow - needs to be "charged" over 100% - because you are using boosts.

dont switch to summoner, unless you are desperate.

multi-flame - T6 - why? you are omnimancer- use multiflame2.

Wildfire3 - thats T9 skill, not T6?

Transference - very nice skill for magic users.

for raids, multi-element skills tend to work very well.
